title: BenchmarkContextWindowCLIContract
description: Interface contract for scripts/benchmark_context_window.py CLI arguments and execution options

all.description: When true, iterates over all candidate LLM models in config/model_catalog.json sequentially for fine-grained binary search benchmarking.

fine_grained.description: Runs fine-grained 2-stage binary search (512/1024 alignment) for context scaling limits.

model.description: Target single model ID to benchmark when --all is not specified.

force_overwrite_profiles.description: Allows overwriting existing valid profile entries in config/model_context_profiles.json.
